source: ESPN public injury report and game summaries

injuries.name: Dennis Schroder
injuries.short_comment: Schroder has been diagnosed with a left hamstring strain and will be reevaluated in two weeks, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
injuries.long_comment: Schroder, who missed Friday's game due to what was described as a left thigh injury, has been diagnosed with a hamstring strain. He is set to be reevaluated in two weeks, suggesting he will miss at least the next five games. Christian Anderson and Sion James could see extra minutes with Schroder sidelined.

injuries.name: Grayson Allen
injuries.short_comment: Allen (concussion) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Grizzlies.
injuries.long_comment: Allen is set to miss a third consecutive contest due to a concussion. Sion James will continue to start while Royce O'Neale should get more minutes off the bench.

injuries.name: Grant Williams
injuries.short_comment: Williams (hamstring) won't play Monday's game against the Grizzlies.
injuries.long_comment: Williams will miss a second consecutive game due to right hamstring injury management. Royce O'Neale and Tidjane Salaun should continue to see more minutes off the bench for Charlotte.

injuries.name: Brandon Miller
injuries.short_comment: Miller is probable for Monday's game against the Grizzlies due to a right knee contusion.
injuries.long_comment: Miller is dealing with a right knee bone bruise, but he is expected to suit up Monday. In three games since returning from a groin injury, Miller has averaged 17.3 points, 4.0 rebounds and 3.7 assists in 29.7 minutes per contest.

injuries.name: Kon Knueppel
injuries.short_comment: Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.
injuries.long_comment: Knueppel missed the first eight games of the 2026-27 campaign. He returned for the 114-104 loss to Brooklyn on Wednesday, though he exited the contest after just six minutes of work and didn't return. With Knueppel out of commission for at least a month, Grayson Allen and Sion James are candidates to replace him in the starting lineup, especially with Dennis Schroder (hamstring) sidelined for a minimum of two weeks.

injuries.name: Jerami Grant
injuries.short_comment: Grant was diagnosed with a grade 1 left calf strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks.
injuries.long_comment: Grant suffered the injury during Thursday's 126-98 victory over Golden State. He will now be sidelined for at least two weeks, with the team expected to provide an update on his condition at that time. While Grant is on the shelf, Taylor Hendricks and Kris Murray are candidates for more minutes.

injuries.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
injuries.short_comment: Pippen (back) is progressing in his recovery but is still considered week-to-week.
injuries.long_comment: Pippen hasn't played since Oct. 29 due to a lumbar disc herniation and remains without a firm timetable to return.  Cam Spencer and Javon Small will likely continue seeing increased playing time in Pippen's absence.

injuries.name: Cameron Boozer
injuries.short_comment: Boozer (ankle) won't play Monday's game against the Hornets.
injuries.long_comment: Boozer will miss a second straight outing due to a sprained right ankle. Jahmai Mashack got the start during Saturday's 104-95 loss to Minnesota, but we'll have to wait and see if Memphis opts to switch things up versus Charlotte. With Boozer sidelined, Isaiah Stewart and Taylor Hendricks will continue earning extra minutes.

injuries.name: Richie Saunders
injuries.short_comment: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
injuries.long_comment: Saunders is still on the mend from a torn right ACL that he suffered during his final year at BYU. However, he has been cleared for on-court activities and will be allowed to practice with the Grizzlies now that he's officially signed with the team.

injuries.name: GG Jackson
injuries.short_comment: Jackson underwent a procedure Wednesday to repair a broken fifth metatarsal in his left foot. He is expected to recover fully and will be re-evaluated in approximately three months.
injuries.long_comment: Jackson suffered a foot injury in Saturday's 129-110 win over the Nets. Head coach Tuomas Iisalo indicated after the game that the injury was "relatively serious," though it is now confirmed he will miss extended time. While Jackson is out of commission, Taylor Hendricks and Jerami Grant should receive more playing time.
